title: Nova Scotia: Navy divers see occupants beside two saucers on the seabed
summary: Tim Gallaudet tells of Nova Scotia: Navy divers see occupants beside two saucers on the seabed, about 1960 at Nova Scotia, Canada, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: these divers claimed uh that they saw UFO fo occupants outside these two saucers on the on the seabed and and and that they even took video of it

plain: Tim Gallaudet, a retired US Navy admiral, relays an account he credits to Chris Styles and Brian Fitzpatrick about navy divers off Nova Scotia, Canada, around 1960, during an operation called Sweep Clear Five. According to the account, the divers said they saw two saucer-shaped craft on the seabed with occupants outside them, and even filmed it. If true, it would mean unknown craft and their crews were operating under the sea.
